visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a tan jacket over a white top, walks along a narrow urban alleyway. She holds the camera for a selfie-style shot, gesturing emphatically with her right hand while speaking. The background shows parked cars and residential buildings under overcast daylight. (2) A man with short black hair smiles at the camera in a selfie view, transitioning from the previous street scene. He appears to be in a more brightly lit indoor environment with a red banner behind him before the scene cuts. (3) Inside a beauty clinic, the woman lies on a spa bed with her hair pulled back. A staff member in a purple uniform applies a thick layer of white gel to her face using both hands. The room has soft lighting and medical equipment visible in the background. (4) The man is now lying on the treatment bed. A staff member wipes his forehead with a white tissue. He has a black headband on. The background shows various skincare products and a divider curtain. (5) A close-up shot features a transparent plastic device head containing 25 gold-colored micro-needles. A green circuit board is visible inside the base of the attachment. (6) The treatment begins. A hand in a white glove holds a professional beauty device emitting blue light against the man's cheek. He flinches, squinting his eyes and opening his mouth in a cry of discomfort. Red marks appear on his skin where the device was applied. (7) A doctor wearing a blue uniform, green mask, and glasses continues the procedure on the man's face. The man’s eyes are wide and watery, looking upwards. He appears to be enduring significant sensation. (8) The video concludes with a split-screen 'Before and After' comparison of the man's face. The top half shows his face two months prior with labeled lines pointing to nasolabial folds, and the bottom half shows his face now with smoother skin.

(3) A rhythmic 'click-click-click' sound from the medical device begins. Each click is a sharp, short-duration transient. The male speaker lets out a series of short, high-pitched moans and shouts of 'Ow!' and 'Stinging,' indicating high vocal arousal and distress. (4) Multiple comic sound effects are layered: a 'ding' bell, a cartoon 'boing,' and distorted meme sounds. The music remains consistent but the man's vocal intensity fluctuates between quiet endurance and loud yelling.
